purpose: Hermes upgrade contract. Selects the pinned upstream revision for the next runtime upgrade, answers the five compatibility questions from M014-S05-hermes-upstream-diff §7, declares the rollback strategy, enumerates the pre-flight checks that T02 will execute against the isolated runtime, and hands the contract to T03 (direct MiniMax proof) and T04 (Paperclip adapter proof). Side-effect-free: read-only planning artifact; the actual pip install + runtime mutation is OUT OF SCOPE for this contract artifact and is gated by live operator confirmation.

trigger_conditions: any NousResearch hermes-agent PyPI release past the new pin recorded in pin_decision.new_pin
any new runtime evidence past the 2026-06-04 failure window
any new GSD memory entry tagged Hermes or NousResearch
any change to /paperclip/hermes-runtime on the live VPS without going through the hermes-rollback path
any change to the XIAOMI_API_KEY / XIAOMI_BASE_URL or PAPERCLIP adapterConfig.hermesLocal block
any decision to switch provider registry from openai-codex fallback to a different fallback

current_pin.source: M002-S08 step isolated_python_userbase_install stdout: 'Successfully installed hermes-agent-0.15.2'

new_pin.release_source: PyPI project page (verified by T01 baseline fetch_page on https://pypi.org/project/hermes-agent/)

pin_decision.rationale: Latest verified stable NousResearch release. Single-release jump from 0.15.2 -> 0.18.2 (4 intermediate releases) minimizes the number of pip install + wrapper re-verification windows vs a stepwise 0.16.x -> 0.17.x -> 0.18.2 approach. The upstream Python constraint '>=3.11,<3.14' is satisfied by the live runtime's Python 3.13.5 (M002-S08 confirmed). The hermes-agent CLI surface consumed by Paperclip (provider/model/timeoutSec/graceSec adapter flags, plus the upstream 'hermes', 'hermes-agent', 'hermes-acp' binaries) is documented as a stable CLI per NousResearch upstream; no deprecation notice was observed on the 0.18.2 release page. The cumulative 4-release drift is recorded in T01 baseline §2 and is non-breaking per upstream release notes.

alternatives_considered.reason: Stepwise approach increases total touch surface (3 pip installs + 3 wrapper verifications vs 1) without reducing risk: hermes-agent is a CLI tool whose Paperclip-side adapter contract is small (provider/model/timeoutSec/graceSec) and has no observed deprecation notices between 0.16.x and 0.18.x.
Same as above; staying behind upstream latest stable by 2 minor versions leaves the runtime in an unsupported state for known fixes in 0.17.x and 0.18.x.

Does not address the upstream drift recorded in T01; the Xiaomi/Mimo before-baseline (T01 §6) cannot be closed on the new MiniMax M3 path without an upstream upgrade because the MiniMax provider is only available in 0.16+ per NousResearch upstream release notes. R4 in .gsd/KNOWLEDGE.md forbids relying on snapshot state.

rollback_default.fallback_pin_reinstall_source: M002-S08 install log (preserved as historical evidence pointer; wheel may be re-fetched from PyPI on rollback)

compatibility_review_answers.policy: Each answer below responds to a question in M014-S05-hermes-upstream-diff §7. Each answer MUST cite the upstream-diff section that supports it and MUST NOT introduce new assumptions without an entry in inherited_constraints_remain_in_force.

Q1_pin_within_python_constraint.citation: M014-S05-hermes-upstream-diff §1 (python_constraint_observed='>=3.11,<3.14'), §2 (drift table; live runtime is Python 3.13.5 which is within the range)

Q2_pyuserbase_wrapper_compatible.answer: YES (provisional; pending live pre-flight CLI startup check)
Q2_pyuserbase_wrapper_compatible.evidence: Upstream hermes-agent installs /paperclip/hermes-runtime/bin/{hermes,hermes-agent,hermes-acp} consistently across 0.15.2 -> 0.18.x per upstream changelog; wrapper exports PYTHONUSERBASE and re-execs upstream 'hermes' by absolute path, so version drift does not break the wrapper. Live CLI startup pre-flight check in pre_flight_checks[] will confirm.

Q3_pep668_override_not_reapplied.citation: M014-S05-hermes-upstream-diff §4 (LHA-PEP668-OVERRIDE patch; override must NOT be re-applied at upgrade time unless explicitly approved)
Q3_pep668_override_not_reapplied.evidence: hermes-agent==0.18.2 wheel is pure-Python and ships its own .dist-info with PEP 517 metadata; modern pip (>=21) handles PYTHONUSERBASE without requiring --break-system-packages against the userbase. The override remains listed in patch_reconciliation_plan[] for explicit operator decision; the default upgrade command does NOT include --break-system-packages.

Q4_adapter_cli_contract_preserved.answer: YES (provisional; pending live pre-flight config parsing + structured output check)
Q4_adapter_cli_contract_preserved.evidence: Paperclip hermes_local adapter config flags (provider, model, timeoutSec, graceSec) are consumed by hermes-paperclip as wrapper args and forwarded to upstream hermes CLI. Upstream CLI args for provider/model/--timeout are stable across 0.15.2 -> 0.18.x per upstream help text (verified by T01 fetch_page on NousResearch docs). resultJson.bos must still be produced by the upstream hermes CLI; pre-flight check structured_output will confirm.

Q5_secret_ref_envelope_preserved.answer: YES (design invariant; no upstream change required)
Q5_secret_ref_envelope_preserved.evidence: The secret_ref envelope is a Paperclip adapter-layer construct, not a hermes-agent construct. Migration to MiniMax M3 in T03 swaps XIAOMI_API_KEY -> MINIMAX_API_KEY inside the same secret_ref envelope; the hermes-agent runtime upgrade does not touch this layer. Therefore the envelope is preserved by construction regardless of upstream version.

compatibility_review_answers.summary: 5 of 5 questions answered YES (Q2/Q3/Q4 provisional pending live pre-flight; Q1 and Q5 design invariants). The contract admits live execution only after the three provisional answers are confirmed by the corresponding pre_flight_checks on the upgraded runtime.

pre_flight_checks.policy: Pre-flight checks MUST run against the upgraded runtime BEFORE any Paperclip adapter change in T04. Each check has a command, expected output shape, and pass/fail criteria. Checks are recorded as 'pending-live-execution' in this contract and are expected to be marked 'passed' in upgrade.json by the actual executor at runtime.

checks.name: cli_startup
checks.pass_criteria: exit code 0 AND stdout contains the expected version label
checks.fail_action: block upgrade; rollback if version mismatch

checks.name: config_parsing
checks.expected_output_shape: stdout usage line listing '--provider', '--model', '--timeout', '--grace' (in some flag form)
checks.pass_criteria: exit code 0 AND all four Paperclip adapter flags appear in usage output

checks.name: profiles
checks.expected_output_shape: stdout listing at least the historical 2 profiles (xiaomi-mimo-v2.5-pro, openai-codex-gpt-5.3); T03 will add minimax profile
checks.pass_criteria: exit code 0 AND historical 2 profile names present

checks.name: provider_discovery
checks.expected_output_shape: stdout listing 'xiaomi' and 'openai-codex' as known providers; MiniMax provider discovery is deferred to T03
checks.pass_criteria: exit code 0 AND 'xiaomi' AND 'openai-codex' present in provider list

checks.name: timeout_handling
checks.expected_output_shape: exit code 0 AND no timeout fire (--help-only is instantaneous)
checks.pass_criteria: exit code 0 AND elapsed wall-clock < 5 seconds

checks.name: structured_output
checks.expected_output_shape: stdout JSON object with at minimum keys 'session_id' and 'resultJson' (or a documented equivalent); --dry-run must not invoke the upstream model
checks.pass_criteria: exit code 0 AND stdout parses as JSON object with 'resultJson' key (value may be empty object {} for --dry-run)

rollback_strategy.policy: The previous runtime MUST remain rollback-capable for at least one Paperclip session cycle after upgrade. Rollback is gated by explicit operator confirmation (LFP-LF-02) and uses only the safe_restart_command from paperclip-runtime.lock.json (LFP-S02-02) plus a pip reinstall of the previous pin.

previous_pin_retained.retained_at_path: /paperclip/hermes-runtime (existing install; pip will --upgrade to 0.18.2 in place, leaving 0.15.2 wheel available in pip cache for downgrade)
previous_pin_retained.rollforward_window: the 0.15.2 wheel is no longer the active runtime after upgrade; pip cache retention is the only source for rollback reinstall

rollback_commands.adapter_state_unchanged: no Paperclip adapter config change is required for rollback (the upgrade did not modify Paperclip adapter source; only the runtime wheel)
rollback_commands.paperclip_restart_if_needed: cd /opt/paperclip-sandbox/docker && docker compose -p paperclip_sandbox --env-file /opt/paperclip-sandbox/.env.sandbox -f docker-compose.quickstart.yml -f /opt/paperclip-sandbox/docker-compose.sandbox-override.yml up -d --no-build paperclip  # ONLY if adapter smoke fails after rollback; matches lockfile safe_restart_command

rollback_verification.pass_criteria: exit code 0 AND stdout matches expected version label
rollback_verification.post_rollback_paperclip_smoke: bounded Paperclip heartbeat_run with hermes_local adapter configured to xiaomi primary / openai-codex fallback; expect session id format YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<6hex> AND exit code 0 (per M005-S01 baseline)

xiaomi_configuration_retained.rationale: The Xiaomi provider registry is NOT modified by T02; T02 only upgrades the hermes-agent wheel. Xiaomi configuration is preserved so the Paperclip runtime can be switched back to a Xiaomi-based profile if MiniMax M3 fails in T03/T04. The migration to MiniMax M3 is deferred to T03 (direct) and T04 (Paperclip adapter).
xiaomi_configuration_retained.xiaomi_deprecation_status: NOT deprecated by T02; deprecation is gated by T03 direct proof + T04 adapter proof succeeding

execution_plan.policy: Steps are gated by explicit operator confirmation (LFP-LF-02) and by the safe_restart_command constraint (LFP-S02-02). Steps are NOT executed by this contract; they are recorded for the live executor.

steps.name: precheck_pip_state
steps.expected_output_shape: stdout lines showing hermes-agent 0.15.2 and openai 2.24.0 (current state)

steps.name: snapshot_pre_upgrade_state
steps.note: Requires operator approval; non-destructive (only adds a directory)

steps.name: upgrade_hermes_agent_wheel
steps.note: PEP668 override is NOT included; default install respects PYTHONUSERBASE. If pip rejects the userbase-only install due to PEP 668, fall back to pip install --user --break-system-packages ONLY with explicit operator approval (LHA-PEP668-OVERRIDE).

steps.name: verify_wrapper_unchanged
steps.expected_output_shape: exit code 0 AND first line is shebang (e.g. '#!/usr/bin/env python3' or '#!/paperclip/hermes-runtime/bin/python')
steps.note: hermes-paperclip is a Paperclip-image-local wrapper; pip upgrade must NOT overwrite it. If the wrapper is overwritten, restore from snapshot.

steps.name: run_pre_flight_checks
steps.command: iterate over pre_flight_checks.checks[*].command and record exit code + stdout for each

steps.name: record_upgrade_evidence
steps.command: populate runtime-evidence/M014-S05-hermes-upgrade.json pre_flight_checks_results[] with the live results from step 5
steps.expected_output_shape: upgrade.json pre_flight_checks_results[] all marked 'passed' with captured stdout tail (redacted)

execution_plan.execution_gating: Steps 2-6 are GATED by LFP-LF-02 (operator confirmation) and LFP-S02-02 (safe restart only when needed). Step 3 is GATED by LHA-PEP668-OVERRIDE patch (PEP668 override requires explicit approval).

patch_reconciliation_plan.policy: All 4 local Paperclip adapter compatibility patches (LHA-*) MUST be re-verified post-upgrade. This contract records the verification commands and pass criteria; live executor marks each patch as 'reconciled' or 'failed' in upgrade.json.

patches.pass_criteria: exit code 0 from both tests (wrapper exists and exports PYTHONUSERBASE)

patches.reconciliation_command: echo 'LHA-PEP668-OVERRIDE was applied only at M002-S08 install time (2026-05-29). Upgrade MUST NOT re-apply unless explicit operator approval recorded. Confirmation: operator signs off in execution_plan step 3 note.'
patches.pass_criteria: operator sign-off recorded (auto-mode lane cannot provide; this is a manual gate)

patches.reconciliation_command: run pre_flight_checks.check PFC-02 (config_parsing) AND PFC-06 (structured_output) on the upgraded runtime; both must pass
patches.pass_criteria: PFC-02 AND PFC-06 both pass on hermes-agent==0.18.2

patches.reconciliation_command: diff /paperclip/hermes-runtime/bin/hermes-paperclip <(git -C /opt/paperclip-sandbox show HEAD:docker/files/hermes-paperclip)  # wrapper source is unchanged
patches.pass_criteria: exit code 0 (wrapper source identical to git HEAD)

inherited_constraints_remain_in_force.policy: All 6 inherited LFP-* constraint IDs from baseline §rollout_safety_constraints MUST remain in force through T02 -> T03 -> T04 -> slice closeout. T02 introduces no new constraint relaxations.

inherited_constraints.summary: Prefer Paperclip HTTP/admin routes; never patch Paperclip core source.
Live mutation requires explicit authenticated operator confirmation with PAPERCLIP_COMPANY_ID_OVERRIDE=allow and visible target company.
Forbidden commands (docker compose down -v, prune, rm, volume rm) unless explicitly approved for destructive recovery.
VPS forensics verdict is H-INCONCLUSIVE; no destructive recovery is approved; only safe-restart command allowed.
Safe restart command MUST be the one in paperclip-runtime.lock.json safe_restart_command and nothing else.
Stale ID ledger from R3 must not appear as canonical company_id in any Hermes-driven mutation.
